description: Fantasy Premier League player stats from the official FPL data feed for the current season: the top players by total FPL points with team, position, goals, assists, form, price in £m and the percentage of FPL managers who selected them. limit (1 to 25, default 10) sets how many; position (Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder or Forward) filters. Use it for fantasy picks and player form; for match scores use dev_espn_soccer_scoreboard, for historical results and odds dev_football_data_couk. Read-only. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
